subject: Request: Temporary SLA coverage adjustment during HorizonPay migration
messages:
From: Elaine Ward <elaine.ward@horizonpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: HorizonPay Ops <ops@horizonpay.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Support request: anticipated migration weekend & temporary SLA ask

Hi Kimberly,

Quick background: HorizonPay is migrating a subset of our transaction routing service this coming weekend (Fri 11/27 22:00 PST -> Sun 11/29 06:00 PST). We expect short, planned degradations during the cutover window and a higher-than-normal incidence of P2s (non-blocking but time-sensitive).

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood temporarily relax the P2 contract response target from 2 hours to 8 hours for the migration window and a 48-hour stabilization period after cutover?
2) Can we get a documented on-call augmentation (an extra responder and a named escalation path) for the migration window so HorizonPay has direct contacts inside Redwood while we validate traffic?

We attached the migration timeline and a short packet of yesterday's incident logs so you can see the pattern. We’re happy to sign a short-term amendment or SOC note if needed.

This is high-impact for our launch cadence — appreciate any expedited coordination.

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Ward
Head of Ops, HorizonPay
elaine.ward@horizonpay.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: horizon_migration_timeline.xlsx, incident_logs_20261124.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Ward <elaine.ward@horizonpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Support request: anticipated migration weekend & temporary SLA ask

Thanks for the heads up, Elaine — and for the logs/timeline. I’ve reviewed the attachment briefly; the expected traffic spike during cutover makes the request reasonable.

Proposed Redwood plan (internal + external):
- Temporary P2 response target: 8 hours during the migration window (11/27 22:00 PST -> 11/29 06:00 PST) and 48 hours after for stabilization (until 11/31 06:00 PST).
- On-call augmentation: we’ll assign an additional senior on-call (shadow) to your ticket stream for the migration window + stabilization. Suggested shifts: Ben Carter (primary shadow) 22:00–06:00 PST on 11/27–11/28; Marcus Lin (backup) 06:00–14:00 PST on 11/28–11/29.
- Escalation path: horizon ops -> Ben Carter (shadow) -> Marcus Lin -> Redwood engineering incident lead (if needed).
- Credit & documentation: we’ll prepare a short-term amendment (DocuSign) that captures the temporary SLA variation and any credits if post-migration degradations exceed agreed thresholds.

Ben/Marcus/Grace — please confirm you can cover the shifts above or propose alternates by EOD. If you approve, I will draft the amendment and route for signatures (Elaine — please confirm the DocuSign contact).

I’ve attached a starter draft of the amendment for review.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachments: temp_sla_amendment_draft.docx

From: Elaine Ward <elaine.ward@horizonpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Support request: anticipated migration weekend & temporary SLA ask

Kimberly — this is perfect, thanks.
A couple quick confirmations:
- DocuSign: please route to contracts@horizonpay.com (cc me).
- Stabilization period: HorizonPay requests 72 hours rather than 48 (we prefer conservative validation). Can Redwood accept 72 hours post-cutover?

If we can get the signed amendment by Thursday EOD (11/26), we’ll be able to finalize runbooks and shared Slack channels.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Elaine

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: HorizonPay Ops <ops@horizonpay.com>, Elaine Ward <elaine.ward@horizonpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Support request: anticipated migration weekend & temporary SLA ask

Folks — quick update and formal approval.

Ben and Marcus have both confirmed offline and Redwood is able to grant a temporary SLA amendment with the following terms:
- P2 response window adjusted to 8 hours during migration window (11/27 22:00 PST -> 11/29 06:00 PST) and for a 72-hour stabilization period after cutover (until 12/02 06:00 PST).
- On-call augmentation schedule:
  * Ben Carter — primary shadow (11/27 20:30–06:30 PST) available via Slack/phone.
  * Marcus Lin — backup escalation (11/28 06:00–18:00 PST).
  * Grace Oconnor — will monitor the ticket queue and coordinate handoffs.
- Escalation matrix: HorizonPay ops -> Ben Carter -> Marcus Lin -> Redwood SRE on-call -> Redwood Incident Commander.
- Amendment & credits: I’ve routed the DocuSign to contracts@horizonpay.com (link below). The amendment is time-boxed to 14 days after the stabilization window for bookkeeping; any extension will require mutual agreement.

Operational notes: we’ll open SUP-7214 in Jira (link below) to track post-migration items and any regressions that might trigger credit calculations. Please keep tickets labeled with horizon-migration so our billing/ops teams can filter.

Elaine — thank you. I’ll mark the amendment as high priority and follow up on signatures.

Best,
Kimberly

Related links:
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-7214
- DocuSign (amendment): https://app.docusign.com/temp-amendment/HZP-459

Attachments: incident_logs_20261124.pdf (kept for reference)
